data.one_liner: Saves copies of images and videos to the Android Gallery and iOS Photos library.
data.what_it_does: Copies local image and video files into the device's gallery or photo library under a specified album name and returns the new File instance. It handles recognized file extensions, supports scoped storage on Android, and runs operations safely.
use_when: You need to save captured or downloaded images and videos to the system gallery.
You want a straightforward way to organize saved media into a custom album on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need to query, search, or manage existing items inside the user's gallery or photo library.
You are trying to save raw remote HTTP/HTTPS URLs directly without downloading them first.
strengths: Returns a File pointing to the saved media with an optional choice to preserve the original filename.
Unified behavior across both iOS and Android with background thread processing for large videos.
Leaves permission handling to external packages like permission_handler for flexible configuration.
weaknesses: Does not download remote files automatically from HTTP URLs.
Does not manage permissions internally, requiring explicit manual setup.
Does not search or read existing items in the gallery.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring storage or photos permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist depending on the target OS version.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need pure Dart image manipulation and processing without saving directly to the device gallery.
